attempted_tasks.note: from 'deadline margin reached at task N' lines (exact); progress lines print every 5

root_cause: _gather_cache iterated the KV cache generically; on the Kaggle image's transformers (>=5, no to_legacy_cache) iteration yields raw 4-D tensors and 'key, value' unpacking iterates the batch dim -> ValueError: too many values to unpack. Every task whose lockstep search reached a compaction gather died.
fix: decode.py: explicit API probes (_cache_layers/_rebuild_like) over .layers / .key_cache / legacy tuples; never iterates the cache object. Regression-tested against a layered-only fake that reproduces the failure (tests/test_decode.py).
not_reproducible_locally: local transformers 4.57.6 retains to_legacy_cache and pair iteration
